look.why: A serene pelagic twilight indigo-lavender that gives crisp definition to both the jet-black wings and white underbelly.

size.measure: disc width (wingspan) 4.5–7 m (largest ray species in the world)

habitat.text: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate pelagic oceans, coral reefs, and productive upwellings worldwide.

diet.text: Zooplankton, krill, and fish larvae funneled into its wide mouth by rolled cephalic fins.

facts.text: Possesses the largest brain-to-body ratio of any fish and passes mirror self-recognition behavioral tests.
Each manta ray has a unique constellation of dark spots on its white belly used by researchers to identify individuals.

facts: Memiliki rasio ukuran otak terhadap tubuh terbesar di antara semua ikan dan lulus uji pengenalan diri di cermin.
Setiap pari manta memiliki pola bintik hitam unik di perut putihnya yang dipakai peneliti untuk mengenali individu.
